description:
Mirror of open spatial data published by the Republic of Estonia Land and Spatial Development Board (Maa- ja Ruumiamet) on its geoportal, as GeoParquet with STAC metadata: the national cadastral units with their annual snapshots since 2019. Every Collection names its official download file as source and the geoportal page that documents it. Publisher titles and descriptions are kept in the publisher's English; attribute names and values are Estonian. Map data: Republic of Estonia Land and Spatial Development Board, retrieved 19.09.2026.

**Disclaimer:** a demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for disseminating open geodatasets. This catalog republishes data from its original publishers in cloud-native formats such as GeoParquet and PMTiles, with STAC metadata — open, standards-based and freely accessible to everyone. It is not an official service of the original publishers, which remain the authoritative source.
